# ui:positioning

{% component: "ui:referenceButtons", arguments: { "name": "PositioningViewHelper", "type": "viewhelper" } %}


Create the `positioning` of a floating component like [Popover](/docs/components/popover),
[Tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip) or [Select](/docs/components/select).

The arguments are the serializable options of the Zag.js [positioning](https://zagjs.com/overview/positioning)
schema. A wrong placement, an unknown offset key or a value of the wrong type fails when the template renders
instead of silently doing nothing on the client. Only the options you set are sent to the client.

## Example
```html
<ui:popover.root positioning="{ui:positioning(placement: 'right-start', gutter: 12)}">
    ...
</ui:popover.root>
```

With an offset and a list of placements to flip to:

```html
<ui:tooltip.root
    positioning="{ui:positioning(
        placement: 'top',
        offset: {mainAxis: 4, crossAxis: 8},
        flip: {0: 'bottom', 1: 'right'}
    )}"
>
    ...
</ui:tooltip.root>
```
 

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Description | Required | Default |
|------|------|-------------|----------|--------|
| `placement` | string | Where the floating element is placed, e.g. `bottom-start`: `top`, `right`, `bottom` or `left`, with an optional `-start` or `-end`. | No | - |
| `strategy` | string | The CSS positioning strategy: `absolute` or `fixed`. | No | - |
| `gutter` | int\|float\|string | The gap between the reference and the floating element. | No | - |
| `shift` | int\|float\|string | The offset along the secondary axis. | No | - |
| `offset` | array | The offset as `{mainAxis: number, crossAxis: number}`, both keys are optional. | No | - |
| `overflowPadding` | int\|float\|string | The virtual padding around the viewport edges to check for overflow. | No | - |
| `arrowPadding` | int\|float\|string | The minimum padding between the arrow and the corner of the floating element. | No | - |
| `flip` | boolean\|array | Whether to flip the placement when it overflows. A list of placements limits it to those, in that order. | No | - |
| `slide` | boolean | Whether the floating element slides along the edge when it overflows. | No | - |
| `overlap` | boolean | Whether the floating element can overlap the reference element. | No | - |
| `sameWidth` | boolean | Whether the floating element gets the width of the reference element. | No | - |
| `fitViewport` | boolean | Whether the floating element is kept inside the viewport. | No | - |
| `hideWhenDetached` | boolean | Whether the floating element is hidden when the reference element is detached. | No | - |
| `sizeMiddleware` | boolean | Whether to compute the size CSS variables. Turn it off for a scroll performance gain when neither `sameWidth` nor `fitViewport` is set. | No | - |
